title: Verdaccio console is reachable without authentication
description: The Verdaccio registry interface is served without authentication. Verdaccio holds private packages and, in its default configuration, allows anonymous publishing.
remediation: Require authentication for publish and for private package reads, and keep the registry on the internal network.
limitation: One response body. The rule recognises the Verdaccio console shell from its document title; it does not attempt a login, so it shows that the interface is served, not which data the caller could read.

observation.body: <html><head><title>Sign in · Verdaccio</title></head><body><form method="post" action="/login"><input name="user"><input type="password" name="pass"><button>Sign in</button></form></body></html>
